_help: Settings for the Megalith flatting tool. Edit values, save, rerun. Pixel sizes assume 300 dpi pages.
_line_threshold: How dark/opaque a pixel must be (0-1) to count as line. Lower = faint strokes also block fills.
_gap_close_px: Gaps in the line art up to about twice this many pixels get closed so fills don't leak. Raise if colours leak between areas; lower if small areas merge.
_gap_bridge_px: Where a stroke stops short of another line, an invisible bridge closes the gap if the other line is within this many pixels in the direction the stroke is heading. Raise it for bigger gaps; set 0 to turn bridging off.
_gap_min_stroke_px: Strokes shorter than this (hair dashes, whiskers, cheek marks) never get bridges.
_gap_bridge_angle: How far (degrees) a bridge may turn away from the stroke's direction.
_min_region_px: Areas smaller than this (in pixels) are merged into a neighbour instead of getting their own colour.
_min_speck_px: Isolated line dots smaller than this are ignored (brush texture specks).
_random_seed: Change to get a different set of random selection colours.
_hint_layer_name: Name of the layer the tool adds for your colour scribbles. Any layer with 'hint' in its name is read.
_hint_snap: A hint colour this close to a colour-key colour becomes exactly that key colour.
_hint_min_px: An area needs at least this many hint pixels to take the hint (ignores stray brush edges).
sliver_width_px_help: Leftover strips thinner than this (in pixels), e.g. the gap between two lines that almost touch, don't get their own colour: they join the neighbour they share the most edge with.
sliver_min_px_help: Crumbs smaller than this many pixels also join their biggest neighbour instead of getting their own colour.
_add_hint_layer: true = also add an empty 'Flat hints' layer at the top of the page for your colour scribbles. false = add nothing but Flats.
